D. R. Bhandarkar’s Carmichael lectures on ancient Indian coins: the punch-marked coinage, the coins of the Indo-Greeks, Śakas and Kushans, and of the tribal republics (Calcutta, 1921). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Lectures on ancient Indian numismatics · Bhandarkar, Devadatta Ramakrishna, 1875-1950 · 1921, 252 scanned pages. Published 1921; Devadatta Ramakrishna Bhandarkar died 1950; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
